name: subagents
about: a foreground subagent's prompt, then a background agent's prompt while the main agent works

steps.prompt: /robovac Call the Agent tool once with subagent_type "general-purpose", run_in_background false, and this prompt: "Use the Bash tool to run exactly: touch fg.txt. Then use the Bash tool to run exactly: sleep 6. Then reply done." Wait for it, then reply with only the word finished.

Call the Agent tool once with subagent_type "general-purpose", run_in_background true, and this prompt: "Use the Bash tool to run exactly: touch bg.txt. Then reply done." Right after launching it, use the Bash tool five times, one call after another, each running exactly: sleep 3 . Then reply with only the word launched.
